name: PDF Quote Join
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Select two complete PDF quote callouts, then run Join two selected PDF callouts and check the preview.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. PDF Quote Join is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it in your research notes.
